key_insight: Meta-LSQ replaces gradient-based task adaptation with one regularised least-squares solve, meta-learning only bandwidth, ridge strength and derivative weight.
engineering_relevance: Fast adaptation and exact model derivatives make it promising for few-shot calibration and smooth engineering optimisation with scarce measurements.
method: Represent tasks using a fixed random Fourier basis.
Fit function values and optional derivative observations in one Sobolev least-squares solve.
Share three learned hyperparameters across tasks.
evidence_signal: On 10-shot sinusoid regression, Meta-LSQ trained in 14 seconds with 5.5× lower error than first-order MAML; simulated beam tuning and real sensor calibration showed task-dependent gains.
watch_item: Performance breaks down on non-smooth targets, and in-sample ridge selection can under-regularise noiseless targets outside the basis span.
paper_title: Meta-LSQ: A Closed-Form Sobolev Inner Solver for Few-Shot Meta-Learning
